enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping
enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up, showering, and taking morning chronic-condition medication
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Remove clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Walk to sink. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Open medicine cabinet. Pick up medication bottle. Twist cap open. Shake one pill into hand. Put pill in mouth. Swallow with water. Close bottle. Put bottle back. Close cabinet. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating a quick breakfast, filling a water bottle, and feeding the dog
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and bread. Close refrigerator. Place bread in toaster. Press lever. Open cabinet. Take out bowl and cereal. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Take spoon from drawer. Eat cereal. Open refrigerator. Take out water bottle. Fill water bottle from tap. Close tap. Put water bottle in bag. Open cabinet. Take out dog food. Open bag. Pour dog food into bowl. Place bowl on floor. Call dog. Watch dog eat. Pick up bowl. Rinse bowl. Put bowl in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed for the clinic shift, packing work bag, and checking one-on-one text messages on the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Take out shoes. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Open work bag. Place laptop inside. Place notebook inside. Place pen inside. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open messaging app. Read message. Type reply. Send. Lock phone. Put phone in pocket. Pick up work bag. Walk out of bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Doing the morning school run and drop-off before the shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to child's room. Wake child. Help child dress. Walk to kitchen. Give child breakfast. Walk to door. Put on shoes. Walk to school. Hold child's hand. Arrive at school. Say goodbye. Walk back.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting by public transit to the community clinic
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Stand up. Pull cord. Exit bus. Walk to clinic.

enriched_activities.activity: Working the on-site clinic shift: seeing community health clients, recording notes, and coordinating referrals
enriched_activities.desc: Enter clinic. Greet receptionist. Walk to office. Turn on computer. Open patient files. Call first patient. Escort patient to exam room. Measure blood pressure. Ask questions. Record notes on computer. Print referral form. Hand form to patient. Explain instructions. Schedule follow-up. Escort patient out. Call next patient. Repeat.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break and eating a packed meal
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to break room. Open bag. Take out lunchbox. Open lunchbox. Take out sandwich. Unwrap sandwich. Take bite. Chew. Swallow. Take out apple. Bite apple. Chew. Swallow. Take out water bottle. Open cap. Drink water. Close cap. Put items back in lunchbox. Close lunchbox. Put lunchbox in bag. Wipe mouth with napkin. Throw napkin in trash.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing clinic appointments and follow-up checks with community members
enriched_activities.desc: Return to office. Check schedule. Call next patient. Escort to exam room. Check vital signs. Review medication list. Update records. Provide advice. Schedule next visit. Escort patient out. Call next patient. Repeat.

enriched_activities.activity: Working the on-site school aide block: assisting in the classroom and supervising primary students
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to classroom. Greet teacher. Assist students with worksheets. Walk around classroom. Help student with math problem. Supervise recess. Play with students. Line up students. Walk back to classroom. Read story to class. Dismiss students.

enriched_activities.activity: Making a short community visit and picking up a few budgeted household errands
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to community center. Greet community member. Discuss health concerns. Provide information. Walk to grocery store. Pick up bread. Pick up milk. Walk to checkout. Pay cashier. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home by public transit
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Stand up. Pull cord. Exit bus. Walk home.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing hands and freshening up after the commute
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Apply soap. Rub hands together. Rinse hands. Turn off tap. Dry hands with towel. Splash water on face. Dry face. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating dinner
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to dining room. Sit at table. Pick up fork. Take food from plate. Bring to mouth. Chew. Swallow. Repeat. Pick up cup. Drink water. Put cup down. Pick up napkin. Wipe mouth. Stand up. Pick up plate. Walk to kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Clearing the table, washing dishes, and wiping down the counters
enriched_activities.desc: Scrape food into trash. Stack plates. Carry to sink. Turn on tap. Rinse plates. Apply soap to sponge. Scrub plate. Rinse plate. Place in dish rack. Repeat for all dishes. Turn off tap. Pick up cloth. Wet cloth. Wipe counter. Rinse cloth. Wring cloth. Hang cloth. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Sending one-on-one text check-ins to relatives and neighbors and reviewing the next day's appointments
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up phone. Unlock. Open messaging app. Select relative. Type message. Send. Select neighbor. Type message. Send. Open appointment book. Read schedule. Write notes. Close book. Stand up. Walk to study.

enriched_activities.activity: Walking the dog around the neighborhood
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to door. Pick up leash. Call dog. Attach leash to collar. Open door. Walk out. Walk down street. Stop. Wait for dog. Continue walking. Turn corner. Walk back. Open door. Remove leash. Hang leash. Walk inside.

enriched_activities.activity: Reviewing community outreach paperwork and scheduling upcoming visits on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to study. Turn on light. Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open scheduling software. Review paperwork. Type notes. Make phone calls. Schedule visits. Save file. Close software. Turn off computer. Stand up. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Night routine: brushing teeth, washing face, and taking evening medication
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Put toothbrush down. Turn on tap. Wet face. Apply cleanser. Rub face. Rinse face. Dry face. Open medicine cabinet. Take medication bottle. Open cap. Take pill. Swallow. Close cap. Put bottle back. Close cabinet. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down with the desk lamp on, reading a few text messages and relaxing before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on desk lamp. Sit on bed. Pick up phone. Unlock. Open messaging app. Read messages. Type reply. Send. Put phone down. Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Close book. Put book down. Turn off desk lamp. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping
enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Sleep.
